subject: Greenline MAP: pilot → production commit and discount request
messages:
From: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@greenline.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@greenline.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + pricing outline for pilot and commit

Ben —

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out what Greenline needs to validate in a 6‑week evaluation and what success looks like for a production commit. High level: pilot (6 weeks), integration (2–4 weeks), production ramp to ~1M tokens/month within Q3.

Two asks from our side:
- Target discount around 20% off list for a 12‑month commitment starting at production.
- Clear milestones and a rollback clause if latency or throughput targets aren’t met.

We attached the MAP draft and a high‑level SOW. Can you confirm if that discount is something Redwood can entertain and what internal approvals we should expect? We’d like to close commercial terms by end of March if possible.

Attachments: Greenline_MAP_v1.pdf; SOW_Greenline_draft.docx

— Erin Sullivan
Head of Platform Integrations
Greenline Logistics
Erin.Sullivan@greenline.com
+1 (415) 555‑0176
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@greenline.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + pricing outline for pilot and commit

Erin — great to see this formalized, thanks for sending.

We’re happy to run the 6‑week pilot and are aligned on the milestone structure you proposed. I’ve attached a cleaned MAP + draft SOW with expected delivery dates and success criteria mapped to the evaluation plan.

Regarding pricing: the customer request is for ~20% off list for a 12‑month production commit. That’s above our standard promotional levels for first‑year pilots, so I’m looping in my manager and our commercial lead to surface the right approval path.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Internal pricing approval (VP + Finance) for discounts >15%
- If discount >20%, CEO sign‑off required per discount policy
- Legal to add milestone-based remedy/clawback language on performance SLAs

I’ll draft a short approval note to share with finance. Can you confirm the expected ARR and start date if we sign the 12‑month commit? Tom, can you share projected token spend for Q3–Q4?

Attachments: Greenline_MAP_v1.pdf (updated), SOW_Greenline_draft.docx

— Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP + pricing outline for pilot and commit

Ben —

Reviewing the MAP and SOW. Greenline is a strategic account with good expansion potential; the ramp profile looks credible. My recommendation: offer an 18% discount tied to a signed 12‑month commit and the ramp milestones in the MAP (pilot success → integration → 1M tokens/mo by end of Q3). Include quarterly usage-based true‑ups.

Rationale: 18% limits near‑term margin impact while giving the customer a compelling go‑to‑market incentive. If they insist on 20%+, we need explicit finance modeling and VP + CFO sign‑off; anything >20% will require CEO approval per our discount approval matrix.

Please push the ARR and spend forecast to finance so we can assess impact. Also request Legal to draft the SLA/clawback tariff tied to latency (p50/p95 targets) and ramp milestones.

— Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP + pricing outline for pilot and commit — finance request

Team —

I need the following to sign off on any discount above our standard promotional levels:
1) ARR build (monthly token projections + list price calculation) — attach as a spreadsheet.
2) Expected cash collection / billing cadence for the 12‑month term.
3) A brief note on downside mitigation (e.g., milestone clawback or step‑down pricing if ramp misses targets).

Ben — can you provide the ARR_breakdown.xlsx by EOD? If the numbers show gross margin above our floor at 18%, we can approve VP + CFO. If Laura is pushing for 22%, that will need CEO review.

— Neha Kapoor
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + pricing outline for pilot and commit — finance request

Neha / Laura / Karthik —

Attached ARR_breakdown.xlsx with monthly token forecast and list pricing. Summary highlights:
- Year‑1 list ARR (if commit is met): $420,000
- Proposed 18% discount → effective ARR $344,400
- Proposed 20% discount → effective ARR $336,000
- Gross margin floor (after variable infra costs and estimated cache savings): 36% at 18%, 33% at 20%

I also attached the updated MAP and an annotated SOW with the proposed milestone-based clawback: 50% of the discount recaptures if production SLA average latency exceeds agreed p95 for two consecutive quarters. The customer has indicated they prefer 20% but are willing to accept 18% if we tighten the SLA language.

Attachments: ARR_breakdown.xlsx; SOW_Greenline_draft.docx (annotated)

— Ben
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 12:14:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: Greenline discount approval (escalation for >20%)

Vivek —

Greenline (prospect → pilot → commit) is requesting a 20% discount for a 12‑month commitment that ramps to ~1M tokens/month. Finance (Neha) and Sales (Laura) have modeled the economics; at 18% the margin is acceptable to Finance, 20% pushes us close to the lower bound but is defensible with the SLA clawback included. Laura indicated the customer may push to 22%. Per our discount matrix, anything above 20% requires CEO sign‑off.

Can you confirm approval to proceed with a 20% one‑year contract with milestone‑based clawback? If you prefer, we can present a slightly smaller concession (18%) and close faster.

I’ve attached the ARR summary and the MAP. Ben will take the customer call after we have a decision.

— Karthik Iyer
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ACTION: Greenline discount approval (escalation for >20%)

Team —

Thanks for the analysis and the clear options. I approve moving forward with a 20% discount for a 12‑month commitment under the following conditions:
1) SLA/milestone clawback language must be added as proposed (50% recapture of the differential if two consecutive quarters miss p95 latency or ramp targets).
2) Payment terms: 60 days net, no change.
3) Legal to include an early‑termination true‑up for usage below 60% of the committed tokens over the first two quarters.

Ben — please confirm to Greenline that we can do 20% with those contract protections and get the customer to accept the MAP and the SOW. Once the customer signs, loop in Legal and Billing to issue the PO/invoice.

— Vivek Kulkarni
CEO
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@greenline.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@greenline.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 17:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + pricing outline for pilot and commit — Redwood response

Erin / Tom —

Thanks for the MAP and SOW. Internal approvals are complete: Redwood can offer a 20% discount on a 12‑month production commitment, conditional on the milestone-based SLA/clawback we discussed and the payment/true‑up terms below. Vivek (CEO) signed off this afternoon.

Key commercial summary: 
- Discount: 20% off list for a 12‑month term
- Ramp: pilot (6 weeks) → integration (2–4 weeks) → production ramp to 1M tokens/mo by end of Q3
- Contract protections: milestone clawback (50% recapture of discount if p95 SLA misses for two consecutive quarters), early‑termination true‑up if usage <60% of committed tokens in first two quarters
- Payment terms: Net 60

If that sounds acceptable, I’ll have Legal generate an updated SOW and contract for signature. Can you confirm the target production start month?

Attachments: MAP_final_for_signature.pdf (will be uploaded to shared Drive)

Best —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
